name: Song of the Siren
source:
Venus is a beautiful siren, whose ancestry goes back to the lands of Ancient Greece. Her life is filled with singing and the sea, and she does not know another life. How she is assigned a meeting with a man who changes her view of the world. What will come of this acquaintance? What will Venus choose?

[from [url=https://crgames-vn.itch.io/song-of-the-siren]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
维纳斯是一位美丽的海妖，她的祖先可以追溯到古希腊。她的生活充满了歌声和大海，她不知道另一种生活。她如何被安排与一个改变她世界观的男人会面。这次相识会带来什么结果呢？金星会选择什么？
